meta.description: Use this skill when the user asks about Worktrunk (wt), git worktree management, running parallel AI agents with worktrees, setting up wt hooks, configuring wt.toml, using `wt switch`, `wt list`, `wt merge`, `wt remove`, `wt step`, LLM commit messages, or integrating Worktrunk with your AI agent. Also trigger when the user wants to run multiple AI agent sessions in parallel across isolated git branches, or automate dev server / database / dependency setup per worktree. Always use this skill for any question involving the `wt` CLI, worktree lifecycle automation, or the worktrunk plugin.
